comment: takes_dir holds everything heavy and local: the takes (raw wav, requests, logs, results), their masters, analyses, lyrics and the listening page. It is not in git. ROOTWARD_MUSIC_TAKES overrides it. workflow is the ComfyUI workflow the comfy engine runs; comfy_url is ComfyUI (ROOTWARD_COMFY_URL overrides it); yue2_dir is yue2.cpp (YUE2_DIR overrides it).
